prompt: Hand-painted Japanese emaki handscroll street of Edo about 1805, fine sumi ink lines and pale watercolour on warm paper, exactly matching the surrounding painting. Repaint only the cleared vertical strip so that the left and right halves join seamlessly: the rows of stone curbs along the street front are at slightly different heights on the left and on the right; across the strip, draw each curb row as ONE continuous row that slopes down very gently and smoothly from its height on the left to its height on the right, with no steps, gaps or extra rows; the earthen road between the rows continues smoothly. Keep the same perspective, scale, colours, stone sizes and line weight as on both sides. No people, no animals, no text.
